title: Recommendation
description: The single shape every skill uses to propose an action. A recommendation without evidence is an opinion; this contract makes that structurally visible.

id.description: Identifier unique within one skill result.

skill.description: Name of the skill that produced this recommendation.

recommendation.description: The proposed action, stated as an action, not a topic.

reason.description: Why this action follows from the evidence. One entry per independent line of reasoning.

evidence.description: Observed facts supporting the recommendation. May be empty only when confidence is low and the gap is declared in risks.

data_period.description: Period the evidence covers, as an ISO 8601 date or interval, or the literal 'unknown'.

sample_size.description: Number of customers, orders or sends the evidence rests on. 0 means no observed sample.

risks.description: What could go wrong, including data gaps that weaken the recommendation.

source_capability.description: Abstract capability the value came from. Must exist in capabilities.yaml.

comparison.description: Optional baseline the value is being judged against.

depends_on.description: Ids of recommendations or actions that must complete first.
